email.subject1: pipeline dbt Labs is leaving behind
email.body1:
Chase, saw dbt Labs landed a 2026 Google Cloud Partner of the Year award and rolled out dbt Copilot.

That kind of signal lights up more accounts than a sales team can realistically chase before the buzz fades, and the overflow is pipeline left on the table. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for dbt Labs off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.subject2: the meetings math for your quarter
email.body2:
Chase, quick follow-up for dbt Labs.

With demand climbing, the constraint is usually coverage, and most teams can't say how many meetings it takes to hit the number. So the gap shows up late, and recovering it eats the quarter while reps stay buried in research.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings dbt Labs needs to hit target this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Chase, last bit of proof for dbt Labs.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks with every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how dbt Labs' reply rate likely compares to other data-platform teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?
email.body4:
Chase, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Riding the Copilot launch is its own kind of busy, and I know timing is everything.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a data-platform sales motion? I'll tailor it to dbt Labs either way.
